blocks.text: The Book of Life is not a dogma, for Life itself is the transformation of the impossible today into the possible tomorrow . The Book of Life is not for everyone, because the burden of Choice is great . The Book of Life is the first Book of Initiation, for the one who holds it will never be the same . The Book of Life is not finished, for it is being realized, and a single Appendix opens the veil of what is to come.
